name: Action Restricted
description: Prevents the target from taking a specific kind of action-economy action for a duration — a pure action-economy restriction, no damage or named condition involved.

mechanics.text: On activation, a target loses the ability to take the restricted action-economy action (this Feature's own tier below) for the stated duration. Not the same as a condition that ALSO restricts actions among other things (Incapacitated, Paralyzed, Stunned, Unconscious — see feat.impose-condition for those) — this models JUST a standalone 'can't take X' restriction some spells/effects apply entirely on its own (the Slow spell's own real text is the reference case for the Reactions tier: 'it can't use reactions'). Duration lives in this record's own featureParams.
The target can't take bonus actions — the narrowest of the three restrictions, since most creatures' turn-to-turn power sits in their action, not their bonus action.
The target can't take reactions — shuts down opportunity attacks and any other reaction-triggered ability (the Slow spell's own real case).
The target can't take actions at all — the most severe of the three, since it shuts down attacks and spellcasting outright (the Dream spell's own real case: 'can't take actions or move').
